The '''Velcar sector''' was in [[Oversector Outer]]. It was one of the sectors that comprised the [[Pentastar Alignment]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Velcar included [[Capza]], [[Criton's Point]], [[Bextar]], and [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]]. It was a part of the [[Velcar Free Commerce Zone]].
